action: Enforce FIDO2 security keys for admins, alert on new passkey or MFA device enrolments and tenant-wide exports, and when remediating revoke all sessions, tokens, OAuth grants and rogue passkeys, not just passwords.
actor: COLD RELIC (COLDRIVER, UNC4057, Star Blizzard, Callisto)
attack: T1114.002 Email Collection: Remote Email Collection
T1562.008 Impair Defenses: Disable or Modify Cloud Logs
exec: One cloud breach became a launchpad for the next: stolen contacts made phishing believable. Phishing-resistant MFA and full session revocation are key.
plain: Google says a Russian spy group stole one US organisation's staff lists and files, then pretended to be its employees to trick and break into a second organisation.

key_findings: In late 2025 COLD RELIC used stolen Super Admin credentials, an MFA push-fatigue attack and a residential proxy near the victim to enter a US organisation's cloud tenant.
It downloaded the whole cloud drive, exported staff lists, ran a tenant-wide Customer Takeout and deleted Alert Center notifications to hide the intrusion.
Unrevoked attacker-enrolled passkeys let it get back in after password and session resets.
In 2026 it impersonated an employee of the first victim over an encrypted messaging app to phish Entra ID credentials at a second US organisation, then bulk-downloaded files.
GTIG observed new COLD RELIC phishing operations as recently as November 2026.
recommendations: Use phishing-resistant FIDO2/WebAuthn MFA and restrict and audit passkey and MFA device registrations.
Revoke all sessions, refresh tokens, OAuth grants, passkeys and backup codes when remediating, not just passwords.
Block or alert on admin logons from residential proxies and consumer ISPs.
Apply DLP rules to cloud storage for credentials, rosters and .pst files, and alert on tenant-wide exports and directory downloads.

summary: Mandiant and GTIG describe two linked intrusions by Russian espionage group COLD RELIC. In late 2025 it used a stolen Super Admin password and MFA fatigue to take a US organisation's entire cloud drive and staff directory. In 2026 it impersonated that organisation's staff over a messaging app to phish a second US organisation through Entra ID. GTIG saw new COLD RELIC phishing as recently as November 2026.
title: Google: Russia's COLD RELIC used data stolen from one US organisation to breach a second
